audit.why: 56.67% Emerald+ is the best number in this slice and the page's read is right — Singed taxes CS early but has no kill pattern on a Kassadin who respects Fling, and his poison is magic damage that Void Stone reduces. It is a farm-race lane rather than a kill lane, which is exactly the shape Kassadin wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two linked problems. The whys array is shifted one stage from index 3: whys[3] sits in Levels 4-5 but describes Riftwalk coming online, whys[4] sits in Level 6 but describes the Catalyst/Rod of Ages spike, whys[5] sits in First item but describes the 2+ item picture. And the chart said Singed wins Level 3, Levels 4-5, First item and Two+ items on a matchup Kassadin wins 56.67% of the time, with captions that read 'neither side clearly ahead', 'the lane tilts to you', 'you stop being free pressure' and 'he can't catch you or out-scale you'.
audit.why: A 56.67% matchup whose own late-game text opens 'This is your game — the 56.67% lives here' cannot have Singed winning five of seven stages. The captions already describe the real curve; they were just parked one row too high and the sides never followed them.
audit.corrected: Captions realigned — whys[3] is now a Levels 4-5 farm-race line, whys[4] the Level 6 Riftwalk spike, whys[5] the first-item stall. Sides moved to match: Level 3 and Levels 4-5 to Skill, Level 6, First item and Two+ items to Kassadin, on win[] and phases[].side. Levels 1-2 stay Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The pages get the single most important interaction backwards. Riot's Mega Adhesive text: 'Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.' Grounding disables dashes, and Riftwalk is Kassadin's dash — so inside the adhesive the blink does not cast at all. The content layer instead tells you to 'blink out of a Fling-into-trail chain or off a Mega Adhesive' (mid), and to 'blink past his Mega Adhesive' (whys[5], spikes[3]). Following that advice means pressing R inside the goo, getting nothing, and dying. Also unstated: Riot's Fling text adds 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted' — the W-then-E order is the whole combo, and the full layer names Fling as matchup-defining when the adhesive is the piece that actually beats your kit.
audit.why: Kassadin's entire escape plan is one dash. An ability that turns the dash off is a bigger fact than any cooldown in the matchup, and it was inverted in three separate fields.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive is now the tracked ability: it grounds, grounded means Riftwalk will not cast, and you walk out of the puddle before you blink. Stated in mid, late, whys[4], whys[6], spikes[3], wants.foe[2], enemyWin, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and loading. Fling's 10s cooldown, 125 range and the adhesive-root follow-up are in dosFull[0] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere — 'never chase into range while it is up' with nothing to count.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 125 range, Mega Adhesive is 17/16/15/14/13s, Insanity Potion is 100s flat. Poison Trail has no cooldown at all, only a 13 mana per-tick cost, which is why 'wait out the poison' is never a plan.
audit.corrected: Fling's 10s and 125 range, and Insanity Potion's 100s, are now in dosFull[0], dosFull[2] and breakdown.cooldowns.

notes: The important find here is that both layers told the reader to blink out of Mega Adhesive. Riot's own text says it grounds, and grounding disables Riftwalk, so the advice as written gets people killed — that is now inverted on the page. Left alone: content early says 'his Fling can flip you over him into the trail', which matches Riot's Fling text, and 'your Null Sphere shield won't out-value standing in poison', which is a judgement call I did not touch. Standing kit-flag misfire, same as the other Kassadin files: _missing-interactions.json says 'Singed can cancel your Null Sphere (Q) with Fling (E)' because kassadin.json wrongly tags Null Sphere as a channel; Riot has Null Sphere interrupting channels rather than being one, so that row is not on the page.
